```{r setup}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
bills    <- load_bills()
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)

# Render one committee's vote table (or a note if it has no votes yet).
vote_table <- function(code) {
  dat <- votes[[code]]
  if (is.null(dat)) {
    cat("No votes have been taken in this committee yet.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Summaries only — the full roll call for each vote lives on the
  # bill's own page.
  dat |>
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_measure, url_slug), by = c("Bill" = "bill_measure")) |>
    mutate(Bill = ifelse(is.na(url_slug), Bill,
                         sprintf("[%s](%s/%s.html)", Bill, BILL_PAGES_DIR, url_slug))) |>
    select(Date, Bill, Vote, Result, Dem_percent_sign, Rep_percent_sign) |>
    arrange(desc(Date)) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = "Bill") |>
    tab_options(table.width = pct(100)) |>
    cols_label(
      Vote = "Vote (Aye-No-Abstain-Absent)",
      Dem_percent_sign = "Democrat Support",
      Rep_percent_sign = "Republican Support"
    ) |>
    sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") |>
    opt_interactive(
      use_sorting = TRUE,
      use_search = TRUE,
      use_filters = FALSE,
      use_resizers = TRUE,
      use_highlight = TRUE,
      page_size_default = 20
    ) |>
    opt_row_striping()
}
```
